title: CPI(M) leader P. Rajeeve flays police action against protesters in Keralam’s Thiruvananthapuram

ai.summary: CPI(M) leader P. Rajeeve criticized police actions in Thiruvananthapuram and government handling of public service commission rank lists, accusing authorities of suppressing agitations and reversing assurances.
